bio: This local institution boasting an idyllic location on the shore of Lake Hossegor extends a charming welcome to its guests. Chef Philippe Moreno, a protégé of Gérald Passedat, serves carefully prepared, high-quality cuisine, with well-executed dishes organised into a seasonal menu and a tasting menu. Fish from Capbreton's fish market and excellent poultry from the Landes area take pride of place. Enjoy your meal in the bright bistro interior, or on the pleasant terrace, in a chic, laid-back atmosphere....
